title: Review of FCH cargo fission (SIWD): replicated on seed 5 with the chi=0 control; Supported for S, I, W, D
summary: After the claim's sheet and fission strips, I re-ran world.py and world_chi0.py on seed 5 (100 frames, t=400). From white noise 34 micelles form by t=16. A synchronized fission wave at t~150-170 doubles them (dumbbells pinch, sheet t=156-172), and a second wave starts at t~384; labkit counts 19 persistent splits, max generation 2, 0 merges. With the author's cargo_contrast.py every body holds the cargo at >= 8.2x the outside in every frame from t=40 to t=400 (aggregate 750-1220x), including both daughters after the wave. With chi=0 the same bodies and divisions occur (labkit counts are identical) but the contrast is 2.0 at t=40 and 1.0-1.1 from t=120 on.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: white noise over the whole domain; micelles by t=16
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: compact micelles persist between fission waves (t=36-140 and 192-380) at constant size
observations.W: cargo_contrast.txt: every body >= 8.2x the outside at every recorded frame t=40-400; rerun_chi0 (my chi=0 run, same seed) 1.0-1.1x from t=120
observations.D: rerun/lineage.png: 19 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges; sheet t=156-172 shows dumbbells pinching into two micelles that stay apart and keep cargo

verdicts.limitation: Containment is affinity partitioning of a passive cargo into the amphiphile core (potential chi u), not a wall, and the cargo does nothing for the body, so inheritance is automatic once it partitions. Divisions come in feed-driven synchronized waves; on seed 5 generation 2 rests on splits during formation (t~20-35) plus one wave at t~160, so it is a shallow genealogy. No Laplacian-only twin.
